hypothesis: A capacity-derived point-in-time filter should preserve the candidate while avoiding entries whose 100,000 yuan target slot exceeds 0.5% of signal-day turnover.
pool_note: The 20 million yuan floor is derived once from a 100,000 yuan target slot divided by a 0.5% participation cap. Price and amount are evaluated point-in-time. Current names, current shares and current ST labels are not used.
